title: SITC of CCTV system at Diamond Harbour, Bishnupur & Patpur FFM Station under Kolkata Directorate
summary: GeM two-packet bid for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of CCTV systems (IP bullet, PTZ and dome cameras, 16-channel NVR, PoE switches, UPS, smart TV, cabling) at three former Loran-C / FFM stations: Diamond Harbour and Bishnupur (West Bengal) and Patpur (Odisha), under the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhawan, D-372/2 Taratala Road, Kolkata

sites.name: Loran-C Station (FFM), Diamond Harbour, South 24 Parganas 743331
sites.work: SITC of CCTV: 6 bullet, 1 PTZ, 1 dome camera, NVR, 3 PoE switches, UPS, smart TV, 800 m CAT-6, 200 m power cable

sites.name: Patpur Loran-C Station (FFM), Post-Barang 754005
sites.work: SITC of CCTV: 6 bullet, 1 PTZ, 1 dome camera, NVR, 3 PoE switches, UPS, smart TV, 800 m CAT-6, 200 m power cable

sites.name: Vishnupur (Bishnupur) D.N.C Station (FFM), Post-Vishnupur 722121
sites.work: SITC of CCTV: 6 bullet, 1 PTZ, 1 dome camera, NVR, 3 PoE switches, UPS, smart TV, 1000 m CAT-6, 300 m power cable

scope.item: IP bullet camera 4MP network colour night vision, CMOS 1/2.8-1/2.3, IR 51-70 m, 16X digital zoom, IP67, ONVIF (1 of 6 kept as spare per station)
scope.site: 6 each at Diamond Harbour, Patpur, Bishnupur

scope.item: PTZ IP camera, dome housing, 2MP (1920x1080) or better, CMOS 1/2.8, optical/digital zoom >=45X/16X, IR 201-300 m, IP67, ONVIF
scope.site: 1 each at Diamond Harbour, Patpur, Bishnupur

scope.item: 4MP dome camera, CMOS 1/2.8-1/2.3, IR 15-30 m, IP67, ONVIF
16 channel NVR, SATA III, 10 TB HDD or more, 4 HDD bays, expandable to 16 TB, 4K recording, 3-year onsite warranty
Ethernet PoE switch, 8 port 10/100 Mbps PoE RJ45 with 2 gigabit uplink
Smart LED TV 30-35 inch, HD 1280x720, Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.0, LAN, HDMI, 1-year warranty
6U wall mount network rack with power supply, cooling fan, transparent glass door
2U rack box / junction box for CCTV PoE switches (indoor/outdoor IP66) with power sockets
CAT-6 S/FTP cable, 0.57 mm solid annealed bare copper, LSZH
Line interactive UPS 1 kVA with 30 min backup for NVR and PoE switch
UPVC 32 mm heavy conduit, 3 m, for outdoor camera wiring
PVC casing capping patti 3 m each with tee couplers
3 core 1.5 sq mm XLPE copper armoured U/G cable (UPS supply to PoE switch)
Laying of 3 core 1.5 sq mm cable and CAT-6 cable through UPVC pipe on wall surface, clamped with 1 mm saddle
Labour for installation, testing & commissioning of cameras, NVR, racks, TV, PoE switch and UPS incl. wiring and fittings

money.performance_security: ePBG 5% of contract value for 38 months (FDR also accepted)
money.notes: Estimated bid value Rs 20,43,024 (GeM; stated as for guidance only). EMD Rs 61,300 in GeM bid details but Rs 40,900 in buyer ATC; MSE manufacturers/service providers eligible for EMD exemption (bid securing declaration, Annexure-IV); EMD also accepted as surety bond. MII purchase preference 20% (max 50% of quantity); MSE purchase preference L1+15% for 25% of quantity. Warranty penalty 0.5% of unit price per week, max 10% of contract value.

period.warranty: 3 years from final acceptance for full CCTV system (GeM ATC and buyer ATC); item specs list 2 years onsite for cameras, 3 years NVR, 1 year TV

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder Rs 6 lakh (3 years); OEM average turnover Rs 80 lakh (3 years); MSE and DPIIT startup relaxation for experience and turnover
3 years' past experience in same/similar supply; past performance 40% of bid quantity in one of last three financial years
Only Class 1/Class 2 local suppliers (min 50%/20% local content) per Make in India order; ISO 9001 for bidder or OEM

Mandatory: EMD or bid securing declaration, PAN, GST, tender-specific OEM authorisation from same manufacturer for NVR, cameras, rack and switch, signed compliance sheet (Annexure-I), non-blacklist affidavit 2026 (Annexure-V), ITRs 2023-24 to 2025-26, unconditional undertaking (Annexure-VI), bid acceptance letter (Annexure-III)

Technical scoring (min 70 overall and minimum in each head): turnover >= 30% of estimate 16 marks, bank solvency >= 40% of estimate 4, similar work (supply and installation of CCTV; 3x40%/2x50%/1x80% of estimate in last 7 years) 30, time overrun 20, quality 30; lowest price among technically qualified wins
CCTV OEM office and service centre in Odisha and West Bengal; OEM registered in India for last 10 years; products with at least 5 years residual market life
specs: Cameras ONVIF Profile S, G, T (listed on ONVIF site or report); MeitY CCTV/Video Surveillance Essential Requirements order of 6 March 2024 with STQC security test report; BIS certification in OEM name
Primary product category 16 Channel NVR; GeM categories Video Recorder for CCTV (V2), Television (V3), Camera for CCTV (V3)
Option clause: quantity may vary by up to 25%
